description: Postal code field stored as int64 (numeric) but intended to be a string. Contains 30 unique, non‑null values with lengths ranging from 4 to 6 digits (e.g., 6907, 99999, 410633). No missing values. All values are numeric and unique.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert the numeric values to string format to preserve postal‑code semantics (e.g., 410633 → "410633"). This applies to 100% of rows.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to a 4‑ to 6‑digit numeric string pattern, e.g., "12345".
